messages.subject: Project Drake — IP assignments (two contractors)
messages.plaintextBody:
Aisha,

Working through the IP responses. Two 2023 consultancy agreements don't contain express IP-assignment wording. We'll need confirmatory deeds of assignment from both contractors to satisfy the investors' warranty. Could you put us in touch, or confirm if you already have signed assignments on file?

Thanks,
Elena

Elena Marchetti
Associate | Corporate
Whitfield Carter LLP
